verdict.rationale: The CockroachDB Cloud MCP server docs say AI tools can connect to clusters using OAuth or API key authentication and perform read and write operations. That shows agents can be given credentials, but nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped or role-limited API keys (e.g. read-only or per-cluster/per-database permissions), service-account or RBAC documentation for agent credentials, credential lifecycle controls (expiry/revocation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
